description: This file contains the implementation of procurement scheduling and automation logic for the 'mrp' module in an OpenERP/Odoo system, including methods for procurement confirmation, automatic procurement creation, and order point confirmation.

classes.name: mrp_procurement
classes.description: A class extending osv.osv for procurement management, including methods for procurement confirmation, automatic procurement creation, and order point processing.

methods.name: _procure_confirm
methods.description: Confirms procurement orders, validates workflows, and generates a report on procurement status.

methods.name: create_automatic_op
methods.description: Creates automatic procurement orders for products with negative virtual stock, based on warehouse and product data.

methods.name: _procure_orderpoint_confirm
methods.description: Processes order points to generate procurement orders when stock levels fall below minimum thresholds.
